name: Siscon -Saiminjutsushi Onii-chan to Namaiki na Imouto-
original_name: 妹コン ―催眠術師お兄ちゃんとナマイキな妹―
source:
One day, while taking a nap, the protagonist, Kyouhei, had a strange dream.
In the dream, a self-proclaimed evil god said, "I'll give you some kind of magic so you can conquer the world."
Kyouhei gave a half-hearted reply that it was just a dream.

When they finished speaking, he was shocked and his consciousness faded, and when he opened his eyes, his younger sister, Ririka, was standing next to him.

Ririka sternly scolded her older brother for sleeping carelessly.
Half-jokingly, he tried out the magic he apparently acquired on his strict younger sister, and his sister acted exactly as he instructed.
He then became convinced that the events in his dream were real.
Kyouhei had literally obtained the power of his dreams.

I'll use this power to conquer the world.

"Why does this have to be done by me?"

Instead, he plays all sorts of naughty pranks on her, like making her cook in her underwear, stripping her panties and using them as masturbation material, and forcing himself into the bathroom.

translation:
某天午睡时，主人公恭平做了一个奇怪的梦。

梦里，一个自称邪神的存在说道：“我会给你某种魔法，让你征服世界。”

恭平敷衍地回答说这只是个梦。

他们说完后，他震惊地失去了意识。再次睁开眼睛时，妹妹莉莉花正站在身旁。

莉莉花严厉地责备哥哥睡得毫无防备。恭平半开玩笑地对这个严厉的妹妹使用了自己似乎获得的魔法，而妹妹竟然完全按照他的指示行动。

这时，他确信梦里发生的一切都是真的。

恭平真的获得了梦想中的力量。

我要用这份力量征服世界。

“为什么偏偏要我来做这种事？”

然而，他反而用这力量对妹妹做出各种下流恶作剧：让她穿着内衣做饭，脱下她的内裤拿来自慰，还强行闯入浴室。
